infoLinks.content: Due to construction activities, the thoroughfare at Punchbowl train station is closed for an extended period. The slope of the alternate path of travel is steep, for customers with mobility constraints please consider using an alternative Southwest Link bus stop.
infoLinks.subtitle: Punchbowl station access
